# @ts-nocheck allowlist — issue #172
#
# THIS IS A SHRINKING LIST. NEVER ADD TO IT.
#
# `@ts-nocheck` disables typechecking for a whole file, so the production deploy gate's
# `npx tsc --noEmit` step (#141) cannot see these files at all. #141 was added because a
# TS2339 reached production; TS2339 is exactly the class `@ts-nocheck` suppresses. Every
# path below is a hole in that gate.
#
# The gate's "Reject new @ts-nocheck" step freezes this list: a `@ts-nocheck` on any file in
# app/, lib/, components/ or workers/ that is NOT listed here fails the build. Entries may
# only be REMOVED — by deleting the pragma from the file and then deleting the line here.
# Removing a pragma without removing the line here also fails the build, so the list cannot
# silently rot into a lie.
#
# If you are tempted to add a line: use `@ts-expect-error` on the specific offending lines
# instead. That keeps the rest of the file checked and shrinks naturally.
#
# Priority for clearing is blast radius, not error count. The two payment routes come first:
# app/api/payments/receipt/route.ts mints merchant order references (see #122) and is
# entirely unchecked today.
#
# Paths are repo-relative, forward-slashed, one per line. Blank lines and `#` comments ignored.

app/api/payments/create/route.ts
app/api/payments/receipt/route.ts
app/menu/[restaurantId]/my-orders/page.tsx
app/menu/[restaurantId]/v2/page.tsx
components/ActiveOrderBanner.tsx
components/menu/item-detail-modal.tsx
components/menu-management.tsx
components/menu-management-new.tsx
components/menu-management-v2.tsx
components/menu-screen.tsx
components/orders-dashboard.tsx
lib/supabase/analytics.ts
lib/supabase/menu.ts
lib/table-session.ts
